listing.title: Turkish Angora Cat Tombstone Plaque with a Photo of a Cat, Ceramic plate with Your Cat's Photo, Custom Memorial Plaque
listing.description:
In short:
- A tombstone plaque commemorating your cat.
- The ageless pattern with a cat face in a sketch style.
- CUSTOMIZATION: send us by Etsy messages or by email a photo of your cat - we will adjust it to the sketch style and print onto plaque. Full color version of original photo is also available, just let us know which style do you prefer.
- Dimensions: 10 x 7 centimeters (3.9 x 2.7 inches)
- A solid imprint is resistant to abrasion and fading.
- All items are shipped with a courier - we want to be sure that your order reaches you in the shortest possible time!

Having a cat is what guarantees the best day in one’s lifetime, when their cat becomes the family member, but also the worst day in a lifetime, when that family member passes away. Commemorate the look of your wonderful cat on a ceramic tombstone plaque. The tombstone plaque has a smooth, oval finish, and so does not need any setting extra.

We can customize plaques according to your instructions. We can use a photo of your cat and print it in a sketch style or original in full color. If you want to add name of the cat or dates, that will not be any problem for us! Just let us know about your preferences.

Art-Dog is proud to present an entirely new collection of items for all cat enthusiasts. The timeless graphics of cat faces imprinted on the ceramic tombstone plaque will help farewell your pet with dignity.
